description: This file contains shell script functions for managing boot configuration partitions, including reading and updating bootconfig entries, swapping active root partitions, and preparing for upgrades. It is specific to Qualcomm bootdevices and involves low-level MTD operations and environment settings.

methods.name: bootconfig_rw_index
methods.description: Reads or writes an entry in the Qualcomm bootconfig partition based on provided parameters.

methods.name: tcl_swap_active_root
methods.description: Swaps the active root filesystem partition by updating bootconfig entries.

methods.name: tcl_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for an upgrade, setting the boot delay and swapping root if necessary.
